Class SaintService

java.lang.Object
seng201.nunbutblood.services.SaintService
public class SaintService extends Object
Service class responsible for managing the roster of Saints. Handles ops involving the active party, reserves, party transitions, and all of the stat or status updates.

    • addSaint

      public boolean addSaint(Saint saint)
      Adds a new Saint to the roster

      Try to put in the activeParty first, and if not enough space, check reserves. Then if not enough space in either, return false

      Parameters:
      saint - the Saint to be added to the roster
      Returns:
      true if the Saint was successfully added to either the active party or reserves, false if both groups are completely full

    • retireSaint

      public boolean retireSaint(Saint saint)
      Permanently removes a Saint from the roster (either active or reserve). To prevent a completely empty roster, will fail if the total number of owned Saints is 1 or fewer.
      Parameters:
      saint - the Saint to retire from service
      Returns:
      true if the Saint was successfully removed from the roster, else false

    • calculateUpKeep

      public int calculateUpKeep()
      Stream ->Stream Return's the Active party one by one so that we can talk to each of them (sequential list)
      mapToInt -> Return Int values of the object (faster than objects for computing)
      Saint::getUpKeep -> Pick's out each saints upKeep
      sum() -> add's everything up

      This serves as a conveyer belt system where we line up all our Saint and slowly pick out the ones we want, and the things we need, then what we want to do with it.



      .stream() (Line them up)-> mapToInt(Saint::getUpKeep) Pickout each Saint UpKeep) -(> .sum() (Add them all together)
      Returns:
      the total upkeep cost of all active party members combined

    • refreshSanity

      public void refreshSanity()
      Refreshes and restores the sanity of all active party members.

    • allSaintsExhausted

      public boolean allSaintsExhausted()
      Checks whether all currently owned Saints (both active and reserves) are completely exhausted. A Saint is considered exhausted if their current sanity falls below 5.
      Returns:
      true if the entire roster is empty or if every owned Saint has less than 5 sanity, false if there is at least one Saint with 5 or more sanity remaining
